translation_rules: Do not invent historical certainty. Keep the distinction between historical evidence and modern divination practice.
Do not add reversals, merkstave, or shadow interpretations as the default system.
Do not provide medical, legal, investment, or other high-stakes advice.
Keep rune names in Latin transliteration and include the local-language explanatory wording around them.
Preserve HTML structure and attributes. Translate visible human-facing text only.
Preserve canonical URLs unless the page is explicitly generated into a locale directory.
